notes: Wording shown to coaches in the labelling workspace. Edit freely; it is re-read on every request. Change a stat's id only together with its source, since saved labels refer to stats by id.

rating_options.label: Good
rating_options.hint: This part of the stroke looks right.

rating_options.label: Looks wrong
rating_options.hint: The number doesn't match what you see in the video.

stats.name: Arm straightness at the hit
stats.description: Angle at the elbow when the racket meets the shuttle. 180° is a fully straight arm.

stats.name: Height of the hit
stats.description: How far the hitting hand is above the shoulder, in torso lengths (shoulder to hip). Uses the highest hand position within 2 frames of the hit.

stats.name: Arm raise at the hit
stats.description: Angle between the body and the upper arm at the hit. Bigger means the arm is lifted higher.

stats.name: Knee bend at the hit
stats.description: Angle at the knee when the racket meets the shuttle. 180° is a straight leg.

stats.name: Knee bend while getting ready
stats.description: Average knee angle while getting ready. 180° is standing straight.

stats.name: Elbow while getting ready
stats.description: Average elbow angle of the hitting arm while getting ready.

stats.name: Push from the legs
stats.description: How much the knee straightens from its deepest bend into the hit.
stats.when: From the deepest knee bend to the hit

stats.name: Hand speed
stats.description: Fastest hand speed in the swing, in torso lengths per second so camera distance doesn't matter.

stats.name: Follow-through
stats.description: Share of the hand speed kept just after the hit. 1 means no slowing down.
